text:
zara: Starting a short coordination thread for the upcoming changelog push. Scope: migration guide updates (v0.9 -> v1.0), canonical streaming snippets, and a short Known Issues note for embed streaming fallback. Need everything squared away by EOD Thursday.

jay: Point me to the snippet PRs. I'll run the snippet unit locally and fix formatting.

zara: PR refs: #4477 (streaming-snippets) and #4481 (migration-curl). I left a comment where python still uses old `client.call()` pattern.

miguel: For the migration doc, I'm switching curl examples to the new /v1/streams endpoint and adding a jq extract sample for token lines. Will also check the tokens-per-request cost note.

elaine: Ran quick anchor pass. Two issues: migration.md references `#deployment-rollout` which no longer exists, and streaming.md has an example id mismatch. Command I ran:
```
./scripts/anchor-check docs --fail-on=missing
```
Results: missing anchors: migration.md:#deployment-rollout (2 refs), snippets/streaming.md:example-id mismatch.

docs-bot: CI update: docs-linkcheck triggered for PR #4477. Status: failed (2 anchors).

sam: I can add frontmatter redirects to migration.md to map the old IDs to the new `#private-deploy` anchors. Small patch, won't change content.

jay: Snippet standardization proposal: use `client.generate_stream()` in both py and js examples. Add a short "Older SDKs" note that explains `client.stream.generate()` mapping. Pushed draft to #4479.

miguel: Note for relnotes: snippets in docs now assume SDK >= 0.9.1. I'll add a one-line compatibility callout so customers on older SDKs aren't surprised.

zara: We also need a user-friendly Known Issues blurb about embed streaming fallback. Draft: "On rare capacity constraints, embed streaming may fall back to a polling mode; tokens can arrive up to ~2s later. The system will attempt to resume streaming automatically." Keep it consumer-facing.

elaine: After sam's redirect patch, I can re-run anchor-check and confirm CI.
sam: Redirect frontmatter added in a tiny PR. Pushed.
docs-bot: PR #4479 (snippets-unify) CI: lint ok; snippet-tests failed (1 test). Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.test/4479/logs
jay: I'll look at the failing snippet test tonight. If it's just the function name mismatch, updating tests is fine; if it's runtime, we'll flag it in relnotes.
miguel: Also double-check the migration guide paragraph on batching defaults 1I updated cost wording there to note that default server-side batching reduces per-token charges in production.
zara: Plan: finish content edits by Thursday noon, final copy pass Thursday afternoon, publish Friday midday. Ping this thread when PRs are green. :rocket:
